{{Quote|Breathe deep, brother. This may be the last fresh air we ever taste.|The prisoner, to Cassian Andor|<ref name="Narkina" />}}
A [[human]] '''prisoner''' served [[time]] at an [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|Imperial Prison Complex]] on the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Narkina" /> In [[5 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{AndorDate|108}}</ref> they spoke to the [[Axis network|rebel]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] about the quality of [[Atmosphere|air]] on the moon after arriving at the facility.<ref name="Narkina" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The prisoner first appeared in the [[Andor Season 1|''Andor'' Season 1]] episode "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]],"<ref name="Narkina" /> which released on [[October 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Asheq Akhtar]] and credited as "Fellow Prisoner."<ref name="Narkina" />
